WITH rental_totals AS (
  SELECT 
    r.rental_id, 
    i.store_id,
    COALESCE(SUM(p.amount), 0) AS payment_total
  FROM rental r
  JOIN inventory i ON i.inventory_id = r.inventory_id
  LEFT JOIN payment p ON p.rental_id = r.rental_id
  GROUP BY r.rental_id, i.store_id
),
overall_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(payment_total) AS avg_payment
  FROM rental_totals
)
SELECT 
  rt.store_id,
  SUM(rt.payment_total) AS sum_payment_totals,
  AVG(rt.payment_total - oa.avg_payment) AS avg_excess
FROM rental_totals rt
CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa
WHERE rt.payment_total > oa.avg_payment
GROUP BY rt.store_id
ORDER BY rt.store_id
